ideas.pitch: An ESP32 and LoRa-powered decentralized mesh communication system designed for emergency services during total cellular and power blackouts in remote terrains.
ideas.title: AeroMesh IoT: Offline Disaster Mesh Network for First Responders
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core judging criterion of practical problem-solving for India's infrastructure challenges, following the exact pattern of hardware-software integration seen in HACKATHON-prahari-link-TEAM-SB.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered platform utilizing multi-spectral satellite imagery and computer vision models to detect early crop stress and unauthorized land usage changes.
ideas.title: AgriSentry AI: Satellite Monitoring for Agricultural Land and Crop Stress
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages geospatial data analysis which is highly attractive to national-level judges looking for impactful societal applications, mirroring the success of GeoNex-ATLAS.

ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision tool using MediaPipe Pose to analyze worker posture in industrial environments and flag repetitive strain injury risks instantly.
ideas.title: PoseGuard: Biomechanical Workplace Ergonomic & Injury Prevention System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines lightweight machine learning with immediate utility, following the proven architecture of CricketVision_AI by running inference locally without expensive cloud dependencies.

ideas.pitch: An anti-money laundering risk scoring platform that merges graph neural networks with gradient boosting to flag suspicious financial transfer chains.
ideas.title: FinGraph AML: AWS-Powered Graph Intelligence for Transaction Risk Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs complex data structures and explainable AI models, satisfying judges who look for high technical depth similar to the Bito platform.

ideas.pitch: A localized security information and event management tool that ingests network packet captures and forecasts future breach probabilities using statistical regression.
ideas.title: SafeChain: Real-Time Cybersecurity Threat Log Aggregator and Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous statistical forecasting into cybersecurity operations, aligning with the predictive modeling precision demonstrated in the AI-incident-forecasting winner.
